messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated error rate detected for /v1/stream (svc=inference-runtime). Auto-threshold: KV cache miss ratio spike + continuous-batching latency cliff. Paging on-call: @maeve

Maeve: acked. pulling logs and traces now. which customers impacted?

Incident Bot: 5xx rate up 6x in last 3m, p95 latency for streaming requests jumped from ~120ms to ~1.8s. Affected models: rdlw-v1-small (quantized) and rdlw-v1-medium. Top sign: KV cache size growth + partial flush errors.

Maeve: tagging @jonas and @priya. heading to #eng-runtime for restart coordination. will coordinate mitigation here for customer comms.

Jonas: seeing repeated OOM-ish patterns in the cache sharding layer, memstore process shows many small entries: cache blowup due to bad prefix keys from a recent rollout. also continuous-batcher shows backlog and token cadence stalls where streamer waits for batch fill threshold.

Priya: on the ML side, recent change to caching key serialization could create high cardinality. rolling that back should stop new bad keys, but existing cache entries need eviction.

Maeve: immediate plan — 1) reduce continuous-batching fill timeout and batch_size to drain backlog, 2) trigger targeted KV cache eviction for affected model shards, 3) restart streamer pods behind canary flag off, 4) monitor customer facing errors. executing now.

Sam: noted. prepping commands.

Maeve: running hotfix — lowering batch config via runtime feature flags.

Maeve: ```
# patch continuous batching config
PATCH /config/runtime
{
  "continuous_batching": {
    "max_batch_size": 8,
    "fill_timeout_ms": 30,
    "enable_prefix_coalesce": false
  }
}
```

Jonas: applied flag to region-us-east. also submitted eviction job for affected KV namespaces (rdlw-v1-small, rdlw-v1-medium).

Jonas: eviction command: ```
./kvctl evict --namespace rdlw-v1-small --shards 0-3 --reason "hotfix: high-cardinality keys"
```

Priya: rolling back key-serialization PR now (rev 4f2b). queued canary rollback for model-serving infra.

Maeve: restarting streamer pods in canary group to pick up config then will roll. ```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/streamer-canary
```

Incident Bot: Event update: after hotfix p95 latency dropped from 1800ms -> 320ms in 90s; 5xx count trending down. still seeing token cadence stalls intermittently on heavy tails.

Jonas: logs show partial flush bug suppressed after disabling prefix coalesce. remaining stalls seem related to backlog drain — some requests still in KV waiting state. flushed those shards.

Maeve: customer impact assessment: 8 customers experienced degraded streaming responses (increased stalls/long tail) for approx 12-18 minutes. Highest-severity customer had degraded session reconnections. No data loss. Impact window estimate: 2026-03-05T14:02:14Z -> 2026-03-05T14:21:30Z.

Priya: adding mitigation metrics: token throughput recovered to 95% of baseline within 6 minutes of eviction and config changes. p99 for streaming now ~620ms, targeting <500ms with followup tuning.

Sam: posting incident note to status page draft. will include mitigation steps and ETA for full rollback of the serialization change.

Maeve: handoff to daytime oncall @jonas in 10m. final ops: keep continuous-batching limits lowered for 2 hours, monitor error budget, and prepare a controlled config re-enable (enable_prefix_coalesce = true) behind feature gate during low traffic with canary.

Jonas: I’ll own the postmortem and the rollout of the safer serialization patch + a cache TTL for new keys. also will add an alert for KV cardinality per-namespace.

Priya: ML action items: add regression test that simulates high-cardinality prefix generation, and add a pre-merge hook that rejects changes increasing key entropy significantly.

Maeve: comms: status page live, sent short notes to impacted customers, CS has templates for followups. Sarah (CS) will be looped for any SLA credits.

Incident Bot: Incident resolved -> mitigation in prod. Marking page as acknowledged. Please file postmortem by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

Maeve: thanks team. saving logs/traces and adding timeline. will include config diffs. closing thread and transferring to #postmortems for write-up.

Jonas: quick note — we should consider a short-lived rate limiter on cache writes per model to prevent blowups from future bad clients. filing ticket INF-4921.

Priya: closing loop: serialization rollback PR merged to main at 1763301420. will schedule safer re-introduction with TTL enforcement.

Maeve: handoff complete. leaving monitoring watch for next 30m, then will unassign. :eyes:
